info.title: Restaurant Space API
info.description: Phases 1-3 backend (restaurants, comments/likes, direct chat). Realtime chat events use the WebSocket at /api/v1/ws; see docs/realtime.md. UTC timestamps; UUID identifiers. Money is THB with at most two decimal places. JWT access token lasts 15 minutes; rotating HttpOnly refresh cookie lasts 30 days. Send cookies with credentials: include. Serialize refresh requests: reuse revokes the entire family. Images use authorized 5-minute S3 URLs. PATCH merges supplied fields; nullable fields can be cleared with null.
